title: Magnesium Sulfate and Bupivacaine for Rehabilitation After Distal Radius Fractures
brief_summary: This study evaluates the effect of 10% magnesium sulfate in the rehabilitation of the wrist mobility in patients with distal radius fracture treated with percutaneous pinning and plaster
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* distal radius fracture treated with percutaneous pinning and plaster
* treated in our institution

Exclusion Criteria:

* allergy to drugs used
* drug use or abuse
* psychiatric disease
* pulmonal, cardiac, pancreatic, renal or hepatic disease
* active infection
